summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 4, 2026, announcing an additional $250,000 cash payment toward its earn-in obligations for a 29% participating interest in the M47c,d oil block in Turkey, as part of a $9.5 million work program commitment. The payment advances the farm-in agreement but does not involve a transaction that redefines corporate control or a special situation. It is a routine progress update on exploration activities, with no board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics beyond contractual earn-in. This is a standard operational update, not a special situation filing.
